instruction: I want to disable the signature separator (the two dashes before my signature) in Thunderbird emails. Can you help me turn off this feature?

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the signature separator (-- \n) by setting mail.identity.id1.suppress_signature_separator to true. This preference controls whether the standard signature delimiter is added before the signature in composed emails.
metadata.verification: The preference mail.identity.id1.suppress_signature_separator is a standard Thunderbird setting that controls signature separator display. Setting to true disables the separator.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly retrieves Thunderbird preferences file (prefs.js) from the correct VM path
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs properly parses preferences and matches against rules
Correct preference key: mail.identity.id1.suppress_signature_separator is the standard Thunderbird setting to disable signature separator
Correct expected value: setting to true will suppress the signature separator (disable the '-- \n' before signature)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact requirement stated in the instruction
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird window to ensure preferences are saved to disk before verification
Metric function correctly handles the rules parameter (receives rules dict directly from get_rule when expected.type='rule')

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
